# Bottle Rocket Growth

> Bottle Rocket Growth (BRG) connects growth strategy, market intelligence, and hands-on execution. BRG is based in Chicago and led by founder Mike Cubberly.

## Core work

- Growth strategy: priorities, positioning, and go-to-market planning.
- Market intelligence: customer fit, account research, and market mapping.
- AI and GTM systems: client-specific agents and connected workflows.
- Revenue motions: outreach, partnerships, ownership, and follow-through.
- Team building and enablement: recruiting, onboarding, and sales enablement.
- Event strategy: audience research, conferences, hosted gatherings, and pre- and post-event programs.
